**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 29  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner made an error in interpreting and prioritizing the release dates extracted from the sources for the films "Gaza Ghetto" and "Kull The Conqueror." While correctly identifying that Gaza Ghetto had a release date of 1985 (IMDb lists May 29, 1985, as the U.S. release date) and that Kull The Conqueror was released in 1997, the Planner misinterpreted the significance of the international release year (1988) provided for Gaza Ghetto. Instead of consistently using the earliest widely recognized release year (1985), the Planner applied an inconsistent logic, mistakenly concluding that the 1988 release in Denmark made Gaza Ghetto "more recent" than Kull The Conqueror. This reflects a failure to correctly align the task requirements ("Which film was released more recently?") to the intermediate findings. The error highlights a misunderstanding of how to prioritize dates when evaluating release timelines across different regions.
